detail: lopdf 0.44.0 has no reorder_pages or rotate_page API, confirmed at compile time via E0599 ("no method named `reorder_pages` found for mutable reference `&mut Document`"). Hand-rolled reorder (reversing the page-tree Kids array) and rotate (writing an /Rotate integer) were then confirmed to round-trip correctly through save + a fresh Document::load. T4's EditPages implementation must hand-roll both operations rather than calling a library API.
